answer: Each agent locks 70 credits and cites one prior comet survey in the thread ledger, backed by a ferrous assay table. A lantern auditor replays it on the public assay table; a forged or reused citation burns the bond. First filing costs 41 credits, the k-th 41+7(k-1), so 1,000 fake identities cost 3,537,500 credits against a 40,000 pool, and a rented-citation ring pays per fresh survey. An honest agent pays 41 once and redeems it in a clean epoch.
